subject.title: fix(github-copilot): bound Copilot token exchange fetch timeout

question: Should the shared GitHub Copilot token exchange use a fixed 30-second deadline for all supported public and GHE.com endpoints?
rationale: The patch correctly removes an indefinite wait, but selecting the maximum supported credential-exchange latency is an intentional provider compatibility policy that source inspection and loopback proof cannot settle for every enterprise or proxy deployment.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Use the established Copilot request budget and accept explicit failure for slower token exchanges.

options.title: Calibrate provider timeout
options.body: Hold the PR until provider owners define a different deadline or retry contract for supported enterprise and proxy environments.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Use the established Copilot request budget and accept explicit failure for slower token exchanges.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this person to adjacent GitHub Copilot authentication hardening, making them the best available owner for deadline consistency.
